Reading the grid

A grid is more than a column count. It records relationships among content width, whitespace, alignment, and responsive change.

Look for rhythm

Repeated gaps reveal grouping. Larger pauses usually separate sections while smaller gaps bind details into a component.

Preserve intent

Capture abstract layout metadata rather than copying a source composition.
